reply: Assalam-o-Alaikum! Welcome to UOS Helpdesk Bot. I can help you with admissions, fees, merit lists, exams, results, scholarships, library, hostel, transport and other student services. What would you like to know?
You're welcome! I'm happy to help. If you have another university-related question, feel free to ask.
Allah Hafiz! Thank you for using UOS Helpdesk Bot. Best wishes for your studies!

I can answer common questions about admissions, eligibility, programs, merit lists, entry tests, fees, scholarships, challans, exams, results, GPA, attendance, library, hostel, transport, student cards, certificates, complaints and campus facilities. Ask me about any of these topics.

For admission guidance, check the official University of Sargodha website and current admission advertisement. Follow the instructions for your selected program, complete the application, submit the required documents and pay any applicable application fee. Deadlines and procedures can change each admission cycle.

Eligibility depends on the degree program, previous qualification and current admission policy. Check the eligibility criteria in the latest official admission advertisement or contact the relevant department before applying.

The university may offer different undergraduate and postgraduate programs across its departments. Available programs and admission status can change. Consult the current official prospectus or department list to confirm the degree you want to study.

For the complete list of faculties, departments and their contact details, consult the official University of Sargodha website. Tell me the subject or department you're interested in, and I can help you identify what information to look for.

Merit depends on the program, applicant pool and applicable admission criteria. Check the official admission portal for published merit lists and selection updates. I cannot verify current merit positions or closing aggregates from this offline chatbot.
Entry test and interview requirements vary by program and admission cycle. Check your program's latest admission notice for test dates, syllabus, venue, required documents and results.

Commonly requested admission documents may include educational certificates and transcripts, photographs, identity documents and any program-specific documents. This is a general checklist, not an official final list. Follow the current admission advertisement for exact requirements.

To check your application status, sign in to the official admission portal using your registered credentials. If you cannot access your account or application number, contact the admissions office. Never share your password or verification codes in this chat.

Fees vary by program, semester and applicable university charges. Check the latest official fee schedule or contact your department or accounts office for the exact amount. This chatbot does not have verified live fee data.

Follow the official university portal or accounts office instructions to generate and pay your fee challan. Check the due date, payment reference and accepted payment methods. Keep your payment receipt. If payment is not reflected, contact the accounts office with your receipt.

Scholarship availability and eligibility depend on the current schemes and their rules. Ask the university's financial aid or scholarship office about open applications, eligibility, deadlines and required documents. Verify any external scholarship through its official provider.

Class schedules and office hours may differ by department, weekday and academic calendar. Contact your department or the relevant office for current timings. This chatbot does not have live campus opening information.

Semester dates, holidays and breaks are announced through official university notices and the academic calendar. Check the latest published calendar or ask your department office to confirm upcoming dates.
For examination rules, registration, exam schedules and instructions, consult the relevant examination office or your department. Follow official notices for changes to exam arrangements.

Date sheets are issued by the relevant examination office or department. Check official university announcements for your program, semester and examination session. Confirm the latest version before your papers.

Check results through the official university result portal or examination office when they are announced. Keep your registration or roll number available. For missing or incorrect results, contact the examination office.

GPA and CGPA are calculated according to your university's grading and credit-hour rules. Consult the official academic regulations for grade points, repeats, probation and calculation methods. If you share your grades and credit hours, I can help with a general calculation.

Attendance requirements depend on the applicable university regulations and course rules. Contact your instructor or department office if you have a shortage, medical issue or attendance record discrepancy.
For library membership, borrowing and returning books, reading spaces, opening hours and fines, contact the university library. Ask the library staff about current rules and available resources.

For hostel applications, room availability, eligibility, fees and mess facilities, contact the university hostel administration. Availability and charges may change, so confirm the current details before applying.
For university transport routes, stops, schedules, fares and registration, contact the transport office. Routes and availability may vary by semester and location.
For a new, lost or replacement student ID card, contact the relevant student affairs or identity card office. Ask about the required application, identification documents and any replacement fee.
For bonafide, character, migration, provisional or degree certificates, ask the relevant department or examination office about the application process, documents, charges and processing time.

For a university complaint, contact the appropriate department, student affairs office or designated complaint channel. For harassment or immediate safety concerns, use the university's designated support process or appropriate local emergency services. Share sensitive details only with authorized personnel.

For verified phone numbers, email addresses and official announcements, use the official University of Sargodha website and its published contact directory. I do not have verified live contact details in this offline chatbot.
For the official campus address, maps and directions, consult the University of Sargodha's official website or a trusted map service. Confirm the destination and campus before travelling.
For campus cafeteria locations, opening hours, available food and current prices, check with campus administration or the cafeteria staff.
For sports facilities, club membership, grounds, schedules and equipment, contact the relevant sports office or student affairs department.
For student societies, events, volunteering and club registration, check university announcements and contact student affairs or the relevant society coordinator.
For Wi-Fi, portal login, account access or computer lab issues, contact the relevant IT support office. Do not share passwords or one-time verification codes in this chat.
For internships, job opportunities, career counselling and placement activities, check official university announcements and contact the relevant career office or department.
